The '''''Lawbringer''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Captain]] [[Hiram Zataire]]. In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''The Rebellion Begins'' adapts ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[5 BBY]].</ref> it was requisitioned by [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], who would use it in his mission to snuff out the [[Spectres|rebel]] uprising on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="TRB" />
